Form 2    34
Shanghai Municipal Police.    787

CENTRAL POLICE Station.
16th March, 1917.

REPORT ON J. Lewis.

Made by D.S.Givens.    Forwarded by.

Sir,
The information given in the attached report regarding
Lewis was obtained from the Chinese servants at his home, No.
94 Haskell Road, and confirmed by inquiries at the offices of
"The Jar." It is incorrect and the
cause of the error is now being investigated.
Further inquiries go to show that Lewis is at present in
San Francisco. One of his Shanghai friends received a
letter from him this morning, which was written on the note
paper of the Hotel Herald, Eddy and Jones Street, San Francisco.
Lewis requested that the reply be addressed c/o Y.M.C.A. of
that city. He stated in the missive that he is at present
attending a course of lectures in engineering at the Y.M.C.A.,
and is making a special study of the construction of gas
engines and electrical accessories. He hopes to return to
Shanghai next August, when he will start a motor business
here.

Mrs. Lewis booked a passage for herself and her family
the last time the S.S. "China" sailed but she got sick while
on her way to Woosung, and turned back. She remarked to an
acquaintance a few days afterwards that if Lewis wanted her to
go to San Francisco, he would have to come and fetch her. She
and her husband often cable to each other. They seem to
have plenty of money.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D.S.Givens
Detective Sergeant.

Chief Detective Inspector.

of investigation

中央巡捕房。
1917年3月16日。

关于 J. Lewis 的报告。

由 D.S.Givens 撰写。    转呈人。

先生，
附件报告中关于 Lewis 的信息是从其位于哈斯克尔路（Haskell Road）94号家中的中国仆役处获得的，并经向《The Jar》报社办公室查询后得到证实。该信息有误，目前正在调查出错原因。
进一步调查显示，Lewis 目前身在旧金山。他在上海的一位朋友今早收到他的一封信，信纸抬头为旧金山 Eddy 街和 Jones 街的 Herald 旅馆。Lewis 要求回信寄至该市基督教青年会（Y.M.C.A.）转交。他在信中表示，目前他正在基督教青年会参加工程学讲座课程，并专门研究煤气发动机及电气配件的构造。他希望明年八月返回上海，届时将在此地开办一家汽车商行。

Lewis 太太在上次“China”号轮船启航时为自己和家人预订了船票，但她在前往吴淞途中生病，遂折返。几天后她对一位熟人说，如果 Lewis 希望她去旧金山，他就得亲自来接她。她和丈夫经常互发电报。他们似乎资金充裕。

此致，
敬礼
您顺从的仆人，
D.S.Givens
警佐。

首席探长。

（左侧批注：关于：- 调查结果
未
侄女已于
上月13日
嫁给 Hume
先生）

                              987
CENTRAL POLICE Station.
20th March, 1917.

REPORT ON Incorrect Information re J. C. Lewis.

Made by D.S.Givens.    Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector.

Sir,
    The investigation shows that since the departure of J. C.
Lewis for America, his wife has rented portion of her house
to a family named Strauss, the head of which is employed as
√ a reporter by "The War."    The Chinese rendering of the
names Strauss and Lewis is almost identical.    When the
Police Agent inquired about Lewis from the boy at No. 24
Haskell Road, it would appear that the latter thought he meant
Strauss.    A similar misunderstanding seems to have occurred
when Interpreter Zau made inquiries at the offices of "The
War."
    Enquiries show that Mrs. Lewis employs Japanese servants,
and Strauss Chinese, so it is quite likely that the latter's
boy never heard the name of the former.

100
21/3
                                            I am, Sir,
                                            Your obedient servant,
                                            D.S.Givens
                                            Detective Sergeant.
Chief Detective Inspector.

See 898 re ds Vonetsch.

1917年3月20日。

关于有关 J. C. Lewis 的不实信息的报告。

由 D.S.Givens 撰写。    由首席探长转呈。

先生，
    调查显示，自 J. C. Lewis 离境前往美国后，其妻子已将部分房屋出租给一个姓 Strauss 的家庭，该户主受雇于《The War》报社担任记者。Strauss 和 Lewis 这两个姓氏的中文译名几乎相同。当警务密探向哈斯克尔路24号的男孩询问 Lewis 的情况时，后者似乎以为问的是 Strauss。在翻译 Zau 向《The War》报社办公室查询时，似乎也发生了类似的误解。
    查询显示，Lewis 太太雇用日本仆役，而 Strauss 家雇用中国仆役，因此后者家的男孩很可能从未听说过前者的名字。

100
3月21日
                                            此致，
                                            敬礼
                                            您顺从的仆人，
                                            D.S.Givens
                                            警佐。
首席探长。

关于 ds Vonetsch 见档案 898。

Shanghai Municipal Police.    787
Central Police    Station.
20th January,    191 7.

REPORT ON M. Rothchild.

Made by D.S.Givens.    Forwarded by

Sir,
    Regarding attached, I beg to report that M. Rothchild, who lives in the Kalee Hotel, works in the China Produce Co., No. 112 Szechuen Road. He has been several years in China and is probably an Austrian subject. He is said to have several Austrian and German friends. An open watch was kept on him from 18th December 1916 to 11th instant, and nothing suspicious was noted in his movements during that time.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
J.P. Givens
Detective Sergeant.

Chief Detective Inspector.

（批：D.C.
There appears to be some overlapping of inquiry work, for as you say he was watched for a month and a report sent in more than a week ago. Is any further information required?
20/1. J.P.G.）

P.S. According to ad. in N. C. D. News on May 18, 1917, Rothschild has severed his connection with Chinese Produce Co and China Export and Import Co. J.P.G.

1917年1月20日。

关于 M. Rothchild 的报告。

由 D.S.Givens 撰写。    转呈人

先生，
    关于附件，谨报告如下：居住在卡利饭店的 M. Rothchild 在四川路112号的中国物产公司（China Produce Co.）工作。他已在中国多年，可能是奥地利籍臣民。据说他有几位奥地利和德国朋友。从1916年12月18日至本月11日对他进行了公开监视，在此期间其行踪未发现可疑之处。

此致，
敬礼
您顺从的仆人，
J.P. Givens
警佐。

首席探长。

（批：D.C.
调查工作似乎存在重叠，正如你所说，他被监视了一个月，且报告于一周多前已提交。是否还需要进一步信息？
1月20日。J.P.G.）

附言：根据1917年5月18日《字林西报》上的广告，Rothschild 已切断与中国物产公司及中国进出口公司的联系。J.P.G.

Form 2    31
Shanghai Municipal Police.    787
Central Police Station.
10th January, 1917.

REPORT ON Various Suspects.

Made by D.S.Givens.    Forwarded by

Sir,
    Regarding attached, M. Rothchild still visits the German Bank, the German Post Office and the German Consulate, otherwise nothing suspicious has been noticed in his movements.
    Nothing unusual has been noted in the actions of Schaller during the past week.
    On Thursday, Friday and Saturday, J. C. Lewis visited numerous exchange shops in various parts of the Settlement, and inquiried about the rates of exchange, but transacted no business. He was not seen yesterday Left for Japan on the "Tenyo Maru" Jan 8.
    Weil seems to be an ordinary business man. Nothing unusual has been noticed about him.
    Dr. Voretsh attends his office every day, and Nielsen calls on him every afternoon.
    H. Glaesser continues to lead a quiet, regular life. He seems to be doing nothing apart from his ordinary business.
    During the past week Nielsen has a few times visited No. 32 Yangtsepoo Road, where he formerly lived.
    Hertzfeldt seems to do nothing apart from his ordinary business.
    Dr. Ito does very little business at present. He rarely leaves his house, and no Germans have been seen visiting him.

（批：Please stop these three watchers from ASH 1/11）

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D.S. Givens
Detective Sergeant.

Chief Detective Inspector.

中央巡捕房。
1917年1月10日。

关于各类嫌疑人的报告。

由 D.S.Givens 撰写。    转呈人

先生，
    关于附件，M. Rothchild 仍往来于德华银行、德国邮局和德国领事馆，除此之外其行踪未发现可疑之处。
    过去一周内，Schaller 的行动未发现异常。
    周四、周五和周六，J. C. Lewis 走访了租界各处的多家兑换店，询问汇率，但未进行交易。昨日未见其身影。已于1月8日乘“天洋丸”（Tenyo Maru）前往日本。
    Weil 似乎是一名普通商人。未发现其有异常之处。
    Voretsh 博士每日到办公室上班，Nielsen 每日下午拜访他。
    H. Glaesser 继续过着平静、规律的生活。除了日常业务外，他似乎无所事事。
    过去一周内，Nielsen 数次前往杨树浦路32号，那是他以前的住处。
    Hertzfeldt 除了日常业务外，似乎无所事事。
    Ito 博士目前业务很少。他极少离家，也未见有德国人拜访他。

（批：请自1月11日起停止这三名监视人员的工作 ASH）

此致，
敬礼
您顺从的仆人，
D.S. Givens
警佐。

首席探长。

Form 2    31
Shanghai Municipal Police
No. 787
Central Police Station.
December 30th, 19__.

REPORT ON Various Suspects.

Made by D.S.Givens.    Forwarded by

Sir,
1. M. Rothchild visits the German Post Office, the German Bank and the German Consulate.
2. Schaller is often visited by Americans, the German Consul, and the Manager of the German Bank. He also visits the American Post Office.
3. J. C. Lewis is a frequent visitor of the Eagle & Globe Steel Co., Ltd., No. 8 Museum Road. He also visits the American Post Office.
4. Nothing peculiar has been noticed in the movements of Weil.
5. Dr. Voetsch intends to go to Tsungkiang (镇江) after the New Year. His offices are visited every afternoon by Nielsen.
6. H. Glaeser appears to lead a very regular, uneventful life. Nothing suspicious has been noticed in his movements.
7. Nielsen is said to be dealing in morphia. He visits the German Club, and the office of Doctor Voetsch every day. Fromm visits Nielsen's dispensary every afternoon.
8. Nothing suspicious has been noticed in the movements of Hertzfeldt.
9. Nothing suspicious has been noticed about Dr. Ito. No Germans have visited his house during the past ten days.

There are five persons employed watching the above suspects. These have been promised $1.00 each day. As they are men who usually live a hand to mouth existence, I beg to apply to have their wages paid weekly. They have now been watching since 11th inst. Therefore there are now $9.00 due to each man, making a total of $45.00.

S.S.D.
Your obedient servant,
Chief Detective Inspector.    D.S.Givens D.S.

关于各类嫌疑人的报告。

由 D.S.Givens 撰写。    转呈人

先生，
1. M. Rothchild 往来于德国邮局、德华银行和德国领事馆。
2. Schaller 常受到美国人、德国领事和德华银行经理的拜访。他也前往美国邮局。
3. J. C. Lewis 是博物馆路8号鹰球钢铁有限公司（Eagle & Globe Steel Co., Ltd.）的常客。他也前往美国邮局。
4. Weil 的行踪未发现异常。
5. Voetsch 博士打算新年后前往镇江（Tsungkiang）。Nielsen 每日下午拜访他的办公室。
6. H. Glaeser 似乎过着非常规律、平淡的生活。其行踪未发现可疑之处。
7. 据说 Nielsen 从事吗啡交易。他每日前往德国总会和 Voetsch 博士的办公室。Fromm 每日下午前往 Nielsen 的配药处。
8. Hertzfeldt 的行踪未发现可疑之处。
9. 关于 Dr. Ito 未发现可疑之处。过去十天内无德国人拜访其住所。

现有五人受雇监视上述嫌疑人。承诺每人每日支付1.00美元。鉴于这些人通常生活拮据，谨申请每周支付其工资。他们自本月11日起开始监视。因此，目前每人欠薪9.00美元，总计45.00美元。

S.S.D.
您顺从的仆人，
首席探长。    D.S.Givens 警佐。

December 13th, 1916.

REPORT ON Various Subjects.

Made by D.S.Givens. Forwarded by

Sir,

Regarding attached, I beg to report that H. Perry, Mains
Foreman, Electricity Department, is about 32 years old, short,
thick set, and clean shaven. He has dark hair, and usually
wears a cap. He arrived here from England about two years
ago. He was then in the employment of the British Isolated
Helsby Cable Co.r which had a contract with the Municipal
Council at that time. This work was finished about a year
ago, and he then entered the employment of the Municipal
Council. Perry has been watched for the past three days.
He seems to spend most of his time at No. 47a Bubbling Well
Road, a boarding house kept by the Misses Laplanche, French
ladies.

1. M. Rothchild, of the China Produce Co., No. 112 Szechuen
Road, is about ? years old. He is of medium height and
build and is clean shaven. He has light brown hair, and
a ruddy complexion. He has been several years in Shanghai,
and is probably an Austrian subject. He lives in the Kalee
Hotel, and is said to have several Austrian and German
friends.

2. Schaller, a German, who lives in the German Club, is about
50 years old. He has fair hair, and a heavy moustache. He
is of medium height, and very strong build. He wears glasses,
and is short sighted. He speaks English, French, German and
Chinese fluently. He is employed in the German secret
service. It is said that he is going to Mukden after the
holidays.

关于附件内容，谨报告如下：H. 佩里 (H. Perry)，电力部门干线领班，年龄约32岁，身材矮壮，面部光洁无须。他头发乌黑，通常戴帽。他于大约两年前从英国抵达此处。当时他受雇于英国独立赫尔斯比电缆公司 (British Isolated Helsby Cable Co.r)，该公司当时与工部局签有合同。该项工作于大约一年前结束，随后他进入工部局任职。过去三天一直对佩里进行监视。他似乎大部分时间都待在静安寺路47a号，这是一处由拉普兰什 (Laplanche) 姐妹经营的寄宿公寓，她们是法国女士。

1. M. 罗斯柴尔德 (M. Rothchild)，四川路112号中国物产公司 (China Produce Co.) 职员，年龄约？岁。他身高和体型中等，面部光洁无须。他头发浅棕色，面色红润。他在上海已数年，可能是奥地利籍臣民。他住在卡利饭店 (Kalee Hotel)，据说有几名奥地利和德国朋友。

2. 沙勒 (Schaller)，德国人，住在德国总会，年龄约50岁。他头发浅色，留有浓密胡须。他身高和体型中等，体格非常强壮。他戴眼镜，近视。他能流利地说英语、法语、德语和中文。他受雇于德国秘密情报机构。据说他将在假期后前往奉天 (Mukden)。
